name: Just Me and My Cat
detailed_description:
WHAT IS JMAMC?

JMAMC is a 2D roguelike, hack-n-slash, wave survival shooter, where the gameplay loop is simple and sweet: grab a gun and kill everything that comes at you! Fight alongside your furry little feline friend, get upgrades to augment your build, unlock tons of new goodies as you level up your account, and see if you can survive with just you and your cat against hordes of supernatural horrors!

GAMEPLAY

The game is simple: grab a gun, survive as long as you can. Every run you'll start with no upgrades, only your gun and your cat, and as the game progresses and you survive more waves, you'll be rewarded with a random selection of upgrades to pick from, that offer a whole range of changes such as increased weapon damage, faster attack speed for your cat, cooldown reduction for your abilities, and so much more!

The longer you survive, the higher your score gets, and the higher your score gets, the more you'll be rewarded at the end of the run with account XP, which unlocks more upgrade options, skins, maps, and other goodies as your account levels up, as well as give you in game currency you use to buy new skins and guns!

HOW MUCH CAN I GET OUT OF THIS GAME?

JMAMC offers a lot for what it is. This probably won't be a game you sink 100 hours into, but you can look forward to many many hours of run after run after run as you attempt to beat your high score, collect all the unlockables, and reach the max account level of 80. If you want something quick, simple, and sweet to kill some time or chase that high score while being packed with hack n slash shooter energy, this is the game for you!

CONTENT WARNING

Please be aware this game contains excessive amounts of blood, gore and body horror in a pixel art form. You can disable the blood settings in the options menu, but body parts from dead enemies and the body horror design choices cannot be diabled.
